playstyle: Draw-Go Stompy per the PRD v2: a creature-dense mono-green deck that already functions as stompy, which Radagast turns into an ambush deck. Five engines: metronome bodies (3-5 MV, >=2 generic, flashed on every player's turn), flash traps (interaction wearing creature bodies - deathtouch grants, ETB artifact/enchantment removal), per-creature-cast draw payoffs, two-humped ramp (1-MV dorks plus land ramp), and commander insurance. Wins by overrun combat (Craterhoof class), the ambush kill, or a big-mana sink. No combo compression. Interaction breadth floor: >=5 answers spanning artifact, enchantment, creature.
notes: Built 2026-08-12 from the pilot's green bulk (pool-green-bulk.txt, ~298 copies) - the bulk-first constraint is the soul of the project: >=70% of the 99 from the pool, purchases only for measured engine gaps (the audit found per-creature-cast draw at ZERO in the pool). Bracket 3 per the PRD posture (turn-13 close, proactive, no compression); revisit deliberately if the pod demands 4. The commander himself is declared via brief.pool (the one purchase baked into the premise); the bulk file stays a true inventory. Steered 2026-08-12: overrun package pinned (the scorer filled wincon slots with poison chaff while Craterhoof sat in the box); the infect subtheme excluded per the PRD (no poison plan). 2026-08-12 slate approved: six purchases (the gas trio, Guardian Augmenter, two utility lands) declared in pool and pinned — the goldfish measured board density as the binding axis and the gas engine is its fix. Emergence Zone declined by the manabase's own hypergeometric (a 30th Forest beat it); dropped from the slate — one scorer. 2026-08-12 dead-clause purge (the pilot caught Knight of the Stampede): four cards whose text cannot fire in this 99 (Dinosaur discount/copy with one Dinosaur, Mountain-gated menace, plus the daybound coin-flip) excluded; four box cards pinned that fix declared weaknesses instead - Arasta, Hornet Nest, Dawn's Light Archer, Saryth.
